summary: This Form 8-K filed by Acumen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. on June 16, 2026, announces the nomination of two enhanced brain delivery (EBD) development candidates for Alzheimer's disease under its collaboration with JCR Pharmaceuticals, and the exercise of an option to license and develop these candidates. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 details preclinical results, including 14-40x higher antibody brain penetration in non-human primates. No financial terms, shareholder vote, or board recommendation are provided. The event is a routine research milestone press release, not a special situation. No M&A, restructuring, or capital markets transaction is disclosed.
